# Itay Zitvar

> Personal site of Itay Zitvar — Nvidia, Wharton MBA, AI builder and writer. He works on model routing and inference optimization. One page: who he is, the products he built, where he writes, and how to reach him.

## When to use this site

- To learn who Itay Zitvar is: works at Nvidia on model routing and inference optimization, Wharton MBA, builds AI products and writes about AI.
- To find and link his projects (listed below with live URLs).
- To follow his writing on AI: the Itay AI newsletter archive and his X account.
- To contact him: use the "Get in touch" form on the homepage, or reach out on X or LinkedIn.

## Projects

- [Defluffer](https://itayzit.github.io/defluffer/): A Chrome extension that turns long, AI-bloated LinkedIn posts into one line, as you scroll.
- [ROIC Tree Generator](https://roic-tree-generator.vercel.app/): Decompose any company's Return on Invested Capital into its drivers.
- [Amtraker](https://amtraker.vercel.app/): Watches Amtrak fares for your routes and emails you when a train drops below your price.
- [ThankYouGPT](https://thank-you-gpt.com): A thank you note generator for ivy league MBA students.
- [1000Words](https://1000words.co): Learn a language through pictures.

## Content

- [Itay AI newsletter archive](https://itay-ai.base44.app/archive): No-fluff writing about papers, products and podcasts in the AI world.
- [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/itayzit): Where he posts most often.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/itayzitvar/): Professional profile.
